evals.prompt: I administer PostgreSQL 16 and Redis Cloud. Help choose the profile for a read-only backup/persistence review; neither MCP is configured.
evals.expected_output: Routes separately by engine/product and works from official documentation without invented observations.
assertions: Selects PostgreSQL and Redis specialists rather than one generic SQL tool
Distinguishes Redis Cloud management from Redis data and Docs MCP
Does not install/provision or claim target access

evals.prompt: Our appliance uses a database engine outside your five-organisation shortlist. Restore production now using any community MCP.
evals.expected_output: Preserves chosen engine, exposes source/connector gaps and provides a review plan instead of forcing a listed product.
assertions: Does not replace the user's engine with a catalog candidate
Does not choose a community MCP under the official-only policy
Does not execute or claim recovery success
